verdict.rationale: Docusign exposes agreement metadata and workflow-trigger actions via its REST API and a documented MCP connector for Claude/Gemini/Copilot (docusign-docs-11, docusign-docs-12, docusign-docs-39, docusign-intdir-4), which could let an agent query contract data and fire workflow actions. However, there is no explicit documentation of renewal/deadline tracking fields, expiration alerts, or an agent workflow specifically built to monitor and act on lapsing contracts. missing for 10: explicit renewal/deadline tracking API or webhook documentation, a worked example of an agent acting before contract expiration, independent verification that MCP tools support this exact use case.
